name: disrupt life
desc:
Each non-[[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} creature within 20 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must make a  DC 18 Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 (6d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Each non-[[lookup @details.type.config.label lowercase]]{monster} creature within 20 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must make a Constitution saving throw against this magic.
